agent: A14 PUCT + Neural Network (AlphaOracle Prime Plus II)
description: Same code/mechanism as AlphaOracle Prime Plus I (PUCT selection with use_puct=false, i.e. plain UCT over this net's own value+policy heads) -- only the weights differ. Retrained on a corpus that adds A14's own round-1 self-play data to the original A11-taught corpus. 'Plus II' is a documentation/changelog name only, not a separate AIStrategyType or roster entry -- see src/ai_strat/ai_strat_puct.h's PUCT_DEFAULT_WEIGHTS_PATH comment. plus1_weights.bin/.json are kept alongside, untouched, so reverting is a one-line #define edit.

architecture.policy_output: 218 raw logits (PUCT_POLICY_DIM), composed at inference time by puct_move_score()/puct_compose_priors() into a softmax over the legal move list -- see ai_strat_puct_policy.h
architecture.note: Unchanged from Plus I -- same fused-BatchNorm export pipeline (export_puct_weights.py), verified 3.0e-7 max diff on the value head and 3.9e-7 on the policy head against the live PyTorch model on this checkpoint.

training.label: full,round1
training.stopped_reason: patience (20 epochs, no val total-loss improvement) -- not a wall-clock budget this time
training.val_seeds_pinned: mirror=40,vs_a7=41,vs_a3=42 -- the round-1 shards only, held out identically across the round1-only and pooled variants for direct comparability
training.note: Per-matchup val_v_mse at best epoch: mirror 0.165022, vs_a7 0.160645, vs_a3 0.139247 -- comparable to Plus I's own 0.148-0.165 range, not a leap in val MSE (this project's own history already shows val MSE is a weak proxy for playing strength -- see Plus I's own PUCT-dial null result).

corpus.label: full,round1 (pooled -- both prior and self-play-generated corpora)

round1.teacher: A14 itself (puct), running its own shipped defaults (use_puct=false, i.e. plain UCT over Plus I's net) -- this project's first-ever self-play bootstrap round
round1.record_format: headerless flat float32, 1692 floats/record (537-float state + 1-float outcome + 1-float num_moves + 1-float total_visits + 128x9 per-legal-move type/count/play/target/visit_fraction)

vs_a3.description: A14 vs A3 (Borealis) -- fixed rating anchor

round1.pre-run_diversity_probe: 40-min probe on 2026-09-22 found zero diversity collapse (0% duplicate states, entropy 2.87/4.14 nats, matching the existing corpus's own 2.94/4.49 baseline) before committing to the full 12h run -- see doc/changelog.md's 2026-09-22 entry.

measured_results.measurement_method: aicalibsrc/puct/calibrate_puct.py validate --weights-b (new option added this session for a direct two-weights-file delta+CI), shipped defaults on both arms, limit_iterations=4000

promotion_gate_vs_round0.description: Delta = Plus II win rate vs A11 (ismctsnn) minus round-0 (Plus I) win rate vs A11, same seeds/binary, re-measured baseline (not reused from an earlier session)
promotion_gate_vs_round0.result: PASS -- CI excludes 0, point estimate clears the pre-registered +2.0pp practical-significance floor. Confirmed via one pre-registered seed-block extension (round1-only variant tied at delta +0.40pp [-1.11,+1.91]pp, n=8220 -- NOT promoted; pooled variant tested next per the plan's Tie branch and is what this file documents).

gate_1_vs_borealis.description: Head-to-head vs A3 (Borealis) -- context, estimated Borealis rating
gate_1_vs_borealis.note: Up from round-0's own 74.53%->~75 (use_puct=false baseline, 2026-09-22) and Plus I's original 62 (use_puct=true, 2026-09-08). Compare against A11's 74.

timing.note: use_puct=false (Session 1, 2026-09-22) is the load-bearing timing fact here, not this retrain -- measured 536ms mean/decision under that default, close to A11's own ~439ms. This retrain changes only the weights, not the search mechanism or its cost.
